jsonld.name: Espinosa Auto Service
jsonld.description: Family owned auto repair shop in Miami, FL specialized in diagnostics, brakes, suspension, AC, electrical and engine repair, run by the same family for three generations.

parrafo.es: Taller familiar en Miami que lleva tres generaciones en el mismo barrio. Diagnóstico, frenos, aire acondicionado, eléctrico y motor, explicado con claridad y sin apuros.
parrafo.en: Family owned auto repair shop in Miami, serving the same neighborhood for three generations. Diagnostics, brakes, AC, electrical and engine work, explained clearly, never rushed.

hero.imagen_alt: Mechanic working under a lifted SUV inside the Espinosa Auto Service shop in Miami

parrafo_1.es: Espinosa Auto Service repara carros en Miami desde que el padre de Otto, Pepe, abrió el taller. Hoy Otto y su equipo, incluyendo a su hijo y a su hermana Luisa, lo siguen llevando igual: hablar claro, precios justos y reparar lo que el carro realmente necesita.
parrafo_1.en: Espinosa Auto Service has been fixing cars in Miami since Otto's father, Pepe, first opened the shop. Today Otto and his team, including his son and his sister Luisa, still run it the same way: straight talk, fair prices, and repairs done to the standard the car actually needs.

parrafo_2.es: Esa forma de trabajar sostiene la calificación de 4.8 en Google con 104 reseñas, muchas de clientes que traen cada carro de la familia desde hace 20, 30 y hasta 40 años.
parrafo_2.en: That approach is what built a 4.8 rating on Google from 104 reviews, many from customers who have brought every car in the family here for 20, 30, even 40 years.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué le pasa a tu carro. Respondemos directo por teléfono, sin call center ni formularios.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your car. We answer directly by phone, no call center, no forms.

texto.es: Revisamos el vehículo antes de decir nada. Ningún trabajo empieza sin saber exactamente qué necesita.
texto.en: We look the vehicle over before we say anything. No work starts until we know exactly what it needs.

texto.es: Te damos el precio antes de tocar el carro. Sin cargos escondidos ni sorpresas al final.
texto.en: You get the price before we touch the car. No hidden fees, no surprises at the end.

texto.es: Te explicamos lo que se hizo en términos simples. Ese trato es el que sostiene el 4.8 en Google.
texto.en: We explain what was done in plain terms. That is the care behind the 4.8 rating on Google.

nota.es: Cada vehículo se diagnostica antes de cotizar. Llama para un estimado honesto.
nota.en: Every vehicle is diagnosed before we quote a price. Call for an honest estimate.

texto.es: Diagnóstico de motor, mantenimiento general y las reparaciones de todos los días, hechas bien la primera vez.
texto.en: Engine diagnostics, general maintenance and the everyday repairs, done right the first time.

texto.es: Reparación y reemplazo de frenos, dirección y suspensión, con alineación y rotación de llantas.
texto.en: Brake repair and replacement, steering and suspension work, plus wheel alignment and tire rotations.

texto.es: Recarga y reparación de A/C, sistema eléctrico, batería y todo lo que mantiene tu carro andando.
texto.en: AC recharge and repair, electrical system work, batteries and everything that keeps your car running.

texto.es: Reparación y reemplazo de transmisión, afinación de motor y trabajos mayores hechos con calma.
texto.en: Transmission repair and replacement, engine tuning and the bigger jobs, done without cutting corners.

pie.es: ¿Tu carro tiene otro problema? Pregúntanos igual, cada trabajo se cotiza sin compromiso.
pie.en: Something else going on with your car? Ask anyway, every job is quoted with no obligation.

items.quote: Have been using them for over 25 years, always great work, fast service with reasonable prices. Repairs are always done professionally with high standards of care and everything is always explained in detail. Finding an honest mechanic is not an easy task in Miami.

I have been fixing my cars here for years. Very professional and responsible staff, including both the owner and the mechanic at work. Special thank you to Otto the shop manager for always being transparent and helpful in explaining what is wrong with the cars.

Espinosa Auto Service has been a family owned business for over 40 years. They are honest, dependable and committed to accommodate their customers. My car is 18 years old with 300,000 miles, husband has a 2000 with 200,000 miles, son has 1997 with 175,000. All cars are still going strong.

The guys at this shop replaced the compressor in my volvo wagon at a great price. This shop was very responsive, kept me updated on what was happening with my car, and very quick. This is the fourth auto shop I've been to in Miami and will be back.
